purpose: Regression guard: joint-Laplace Gaussian/inverse-link GLMM whose fast-PIRLS start collapses to theta = 0. The Laplace objective is even in a diagonal theta, so theta = 0 is a stationary point the joint optimizer could not leave; it reported a converged fit at theta = 1 (one stencil step) while lme4::glmer reaches theta ~ 28.18.
regenerate: set.seed(1); ng <- 15; nper <- 8; g <- factor(rep(sprintf('g%02d', 1:ng), each = nper)); x <- runif(ng * nper); sig <- 0.05; u <- rnorm(ng, 0, 0.5 * sig)[as.integer(g)]; eta <- 10 + 2 * x + u; y <- 1 / eta + rnorm(ng * nper, 0, sig); write.csv(data.frame(y = y, x = x, g = g), 'gaussian_inverse_link_small_sigma.csv', row.names = FALSE)
